name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Shadowcrafting) — 2 Intermediate — Night's Veil

system.description:
Standing within an existing shadow, you cause it to expand roughly a yard further in every direction; so long as you remain within the enlarged shade, the area counts as under the province of night, letting you shrug off daylight penalties and sunlight's burning touch. Stepping outside the shadow ends the effect immediately, possibly stranding you in the light.

This path does not function against or for Kindred with the Flaw: Cast No Reflection.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
system.duration: Rest of the scene or one hour
